npcs.name: Marian
npcs.intro: Marian is one of the elder sisters of Schneider and a NPC in Reverse: 1999. She was kidnapped by the Manus Vindictae and the main motivation for Schneider's joining the faction, wishing to use them to help find Marian. It later lets slip that they were behind her disappearance, and she is discovered behind a wall with Truth Serum flooding her system. It is implied that she, like Schneider, was a human who could wield Arcanist power.
